camila: Quick heads-up  slight runtime tweak before we go live. We'll run leadership Q&A first, then the demo block. Trying to limit continuous encoder load. Everyone OK with that? :wave:
rachel: fine with order change. stage ops will prep the panel.
tom: infra note: streamer-05 showing intermittent ffmpeg watchdog restarts in the last 20m. I want to engage iso redundancy and a backup rtmp early.
jess: AV: can we pin a single wide camera during demos to reduce scene-change CPU? we can switch to multi-cam for Q&A.
camila: yes please pin wide for demos. jess, please also enable captions for the Q&A and route to the iso. last time caption file had a gap.
infra-bot: [ALERT] streamer-05: ffmpeg_restarts=2, cpu=87%, temp=74C. swap threshold cpu>92% or restarts>3.
tom: fallback ffmpeg ready to go, using lower res for demos:
```
ffmpeg -re -f x11grab -s 1280x720 -i :0.0 -r 25 -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast -b:v 2200k -f flv rtmp://backup.stream/redwood_key
```
tom: I'll also start local iso to /srv/iso/allhands-3417772001.mkv now and rsync after the meeting.
rachel: stage ops: lavs labeled L1/L2, handheld on deck. We'll mute audience mics during demos to avoid bleed.
jess: captions: switching to transcribe-pro with 3s commit window. routing live captions to both stream and local iso. expect ~3-4s lag.
camila: perfect. one operational ask: if anyone sees >2s gap in the recording, drop a timestamp + short note here and we'll open a follow-up ticket.
stream-bot: [REMINDER] All-hands starts at 2025-11-04T17:15:00Z. Join panel mic check 7 min early.
tom: backup rtmp engaged if needed. monitoring encoder health.
jess: OBS on streamer-05 reduced scene changes, wide-shot locked. starting pre-roll clips for two fragile demos.
camila: thanks all. joining stage now. maya (cc), I'll share the Q&A doc link in 2.
camila: (after) shared: https://docs.internal/redwood/allhands/qna-3417772001  please add pressing questions and tag [URGENT].
(End of thread)
